text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The Triple Crown is achieved! Symboli 
Rudolf has claimed the Triple Crown!!

However, those congratulations were 
drowned out by the roar of the crowd, who 
had been certain of her victory before she 
even crossed the line—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Thank you all for your support.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She's achieved the Triple Crown...!
(WOOOAAAH...!!)

Instead, cheers roaring like a storm 
celebrated the birth of a Triple Crown 
Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun. ...We did it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Still, hearing such immense cheers after 
all... it truly is deeply moving."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It's merely a means to achieve my dream. 
That was the mindset I carried into the 
challenge, but—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The title of Triple Crown Umamusume... 
Truly... truly, does it not stir one's 
soul and excitement!"

Symboli Rudolf savored the cheers for a 
moment, and then—

She raised three fingers high toward the 
heavens...
Yet, her dream does not end here!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've achieved the Classic Triple 
Crown, the next races I must challenge are 
already decided.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of a race worthy of adding to the 
crown I now wear...
choice_data_list: It's the Arima Kinen, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —That's right.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The seniors already making waves in the 
Senior Year will be running. I shall test 
my mettle against them and prove my 
ever-growing strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Above all, if the crowd believes in me and 
chooses me, nothing could bring me greater 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even the Arima Kinen shall serve as a mere 
stepping stone for my great leap forward.

And so, just as the next race was set to 
be the Arima Kinen...
Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Brian. How unusual for you to come 
watch me."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I was curious to see who the strongest 
Umamusume truly was.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And the winner is... you, as expected. 
Impressive as always, "Emperor".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I couldn't, I wouldn't deserve to stand 
above you, would I?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd like to test my skills against ya 
someday. Sinking my teeth into you sounds 
like fun."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you on anytime. If it's just a 
little love bite, I don't mind pampering 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, is Air Groove not 
here today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps it was conceit to think you'd 
come watch. Or... did something go wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Your prying couldn't be any more 
obvious. That's not like you at all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I haven't done anything to—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you worried whether I'm keeping up 
unless you look back?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, I've witnessed you claim the 
Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well, get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I owe you one.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer-kun. About what Brian 
just said—"
(Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, I'm from the newspaper company. 
Do you have a moment to spare?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not at all. Please wait a moment while 
I prepare it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, let's talk later. Right now, 
it's interview time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Leaving an impression as a Triple Crown 
Umamusume, along with looking ahead to our 
next horizon. We must have the press drum 
up plenty of excitement."

"...However, I was kept busy with 
interviews after that, and never got the 
chance to speak with Symboli Rudolf."
